mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value exceeding 238.5 indicates accelerating inflation, triggering central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 238.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 238.5, it signals a 'hawkish' monetary policy response to inflation, causing equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL > 238.5 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to reduced corporate profit margins and increased risk aversion, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 240 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong economy, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST is above 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals an economic slowdown, reducing corporate earnings expectations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.0% and employment (PAYEMS) falls below 142000, it indicates a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 142000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1 < 16300) signals an economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 < 16300 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
